_note: Read by the platform bake as strict JSON (no comments) -- see src/lib/seo.ts. 'title' is deliberately ABSENT so og:title falls through to each page's own <title>; adding it back freezes every share card to one name. 'description' is the SHARE-CARD line and is deliberately NOT SITE_DESCRIPTION: that one still feeds the name=description meta and the JSON-LD, where a card-length line would say nothing. Keep this under 87 characters or WhatsApp clips it.
